Name: Abijah, Daughter of Zechariah
Summary: Abijah, daughter of Zechariah, was the mother of Hezekiah, who was twenty-five when he began to reign twenty-nine years in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Hezekiah's mother's name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Zechariah, Father of Abijah
LifeLesson: A reforming king's mother is named at the start of his reign.
